description: Live job ads from one job board per call: Seek, Dice, Google Jobs, Naukri, JobStreet/JobsDB, jobs.ch, Job Bank Canada, Foundit, NaukriGulf, PNet, MyCareersFuture, elempleo or a remote-jobs aggregator. Returns title, company, location, work type, salary where shown, posting date and link. Suited to job search and hiring-market questions. $0.02 per call, up to 25 ads.

country.description: Country code for sites that have editions: google-jobs (any, e.g. us, gb, de, in), seek (au, nz), jobstreet-jobsdb (my, sg, ph, id, hk, th).

details.description: Include the full ad text where the site offers it.

input.description: Advanced: a JSON object with the site's own filters; GET /sites lists them per site.

location.description: City, region or postcode as the site understands it, e.g. "Berlin".

postedWithinDays.description: Only ads posted in the last N days.

searchUrl.description: Instead of query/location: a full search-results link from the site, with its filters.

site.description: Job board key from /jobs/sites, e.g. google-jobs, seek, naukri, jobstreet-jobsdb, dice, jobs-ch. google-jobs: Google job search (jobs from every board and career site Google indexes), up to 10 jobs per request.

name: jobs_search
title: Live job ads from one job board
